other_conditions: Parents of the bride and groom must be natives of Madhya Pradesh
Both bride and groom must belong to Muslim families
Bride must be at least 18 years old and not previously married
Groom must be at least 21 years old
Scheme applies only to mass marriage (Nikah) ceremonies, not single marriages
Abandoned women are eligible only if they have been legally divorced
A minimum of 5 couples' applications is required for a mass marriage ceremony to be organized
If the groom is from outside the state, the bride remains eligible, but benefits are denied if either set of parents are not natives of Madhya Pradesh
benefits_summary: Each eligible bride receives ₹49,000, and the organizing body receives ₹6,000, totaling ₹55,000 per beneficiary.
